title: AI Logo Animation Generator
summary: Animate your logo with AI. Copy one of 13 free logo animation templates, from minimal to 3D and neon, add your logo, and Flick makes the clip.
body_markdown:
### Are these logo animation templates free?


Yes, every template here runs on the Flick free plan: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. A five-second clip with MiniMax H3 Fast costs 20 credits, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### What is a logo animation template?


A logo animation template is a reusable starting point that moves any logo in a set way. Many are After Effects or Premiere project files you edit, while a prompt template is a written description of the motion that you paste beside your logo image in an AI video tool.


### Can I animate my own logo with AI?


Yes. Upload the logo to a Flick canvas, set it as the start frame of an image to video clip, and describe the motion in a prompt. A clean logo with empty space around it gives the model the sharpest shapes to hold.


### How do I stop the letters changing in an AI logo animation?


Lock the camera, say the letters do not change shape, and give the movement to light or a separate object. Check the last second of each take, because that is where letters drift furthest from the start frame.


### How long should a logo animation be?


Three to five seconds is the usual length for a logo sting, long enough to read the name without delaying the video that follows. Every clip on this page was generated at five seconds.


### Can I make a 3D logo animation without 3D software?


Yes. Describe your logo as a 3D object in an image prompt, with its material, lighting and backdrop, then animate that picture with a video model. The chrome, gold and glass logos on this page were all made this way in Flick.
